stroke_tour_closed — PRINTPATH stroke op

• Data kinds: pairs → pairs

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.stroke_tour_closed(points, start='nearest', two_opt_rounds=8, order=None) (to call the implementation directly, import printpath; printpath.stroke_tour_closed(points, start='nearest', two_opt_rounds=8, order=None); from the registry, opsprintpath.get("stroke_tour_closed"))

Usage

Reorders the points into a closed tour that visits each point exactly 1 time and returns. → pairs

Returns (N, 2): the same points as the input, reordered. It is closed by returning from the last point to the first (the first point is not duplicated at the end).

★This is not an optimal tour (TSP is NP-hard). State its quality by comparing with a lower bound:

a closed tour cannot be shorter than the minimum spanning tree, so the closer length / mst_length is to 1 the better. For uniform points, Beardwood–Halton–Hammersley's 0.7124 √(n A) is also a guide. No golden files are used.
